target_section: §5.8 Saved Search belongs to Client + Opportunity — final paragraph
anchor_text: Maya must decide whether Lead becomes a canonical object. §19.1 caps brokerage leads at a simple assignment history — source, assigned Agent, date, accepted/declined/reassigned, response/follow-up, conversion — and §3 does not carry Lead in the canonical shared foundation. A durable Lead → Opportunity → Saved Search lineage whose captured requirements survive conversion is more than that cap allows. Until the decision is recorded, the chain executes from `CLIENT PARTY` and the lead link stays inside §19. **Mallan may not create a second Lead record inside Search to close the gap.**
replacement_text: Lead / Inquiry is a canonical object of the shared foundation. §3 carries it and §3.1 resolves it to the canonical Party; §19.1 owns its sources, ownership, lifecycle and outcomes. The chain above therefore executes from `LEAD — WHERE THE CLIENT ORIGINATED AS ONE`, and the lineage from the requirements captured on that Lead through the Opportunity to the Saved Search criteria is retained. **Search reads the §19 Lead; it does not hold one.**
rationale: THE ONE AUTHORIZED REPLACEMENT. This is the round-1 hold note Maya's item 4 closes, and two of its three factual premises were already overtaken by round 1's own additions — so leaving it standing would make the plan contradict itself. Its own §5.8 diagram already opens at `LEAD — WHERE THE CLIENT ORIGINATED AS ONE`, so the replacement makes the prose agree with the diagram beside it rather than inventing anything. The one sentence that had to survive — the prohibition on a second Lead record inside Search — survives restated in the plan's own compressed form: Search reads the §19 Lead; it does not hold one. Nothing else in §5.8 is touched. Every other edit in this group is strictly additive.
verdict_basis: MAYA_RESOLUTION. Verified in the base by direct read, not grep alone: §3 L237 now carries `Lead / Inquiry` in the CANONICAL SHARED FOUNDATION list and §3.1 L292-300 carries the LEAD / INQUIRY → IDENTITY RESOLUTION → CANONICAL PARTY → ONE OR MORE ROLE OPPORTUNITIES chain — so the premise '§3 does not carry Lead in the canonical shared foundation' is now false. §19.1 L3438 reads 'A Lead is a first-class record: it is how a person who is not yet a client enters Mallan, and it exists before any Opportunity does', with the full lifecycle diagram at L3412-3436 — so the premise that §19.1 'caps brokerage leads at a simple assignment history' is also now false. Directive item 4 ('The expanded Lead lifecycle governs the BUSINESS RELATIONSHIP') settles the remainder. Anchor uniqueness: grep -c -F = 1.
